name: 男の子（赤パーカー・持ち歩き）
author: kaede

source.prompt: Outfit swap of the carry-walk variant: avatar.boy-basic-carry restyled into the red-hoodie look of avatar.boy-basic-red, via Cloudflare AI Gateway (gateway kaede-assets) with google/nano-banana-2, image_input = the committed carry sheet (~$0.10/枚 ×3 — take 1 predates the both-arms-still carry respec, take 2 softened the strides (silhouette IoU fell to 0.815-0.846, caught by the mechanical gate) and a retry with an explicit keep-the-wide-strides clause restored 0.945-0.957 — the ①b(a) spike round 3, 2026-08-09). Same keep-everything edit prompt as avatar.boy-basic-red (red hoodie + beige chinos, hands bare, poses pixel-identical) with one added clause naming the still near arm so the sleeves follow it. Pose fidelity verified mechanically before import: per-frame silhouette IoU against the carry sheet 0.950-0.967 (the residual is the clothes' own silhouette). This sheet is the composition proof of the factory: pose variant (video line) × outfit (sheet edit) multiply as independent $0.50 + $0.10 steps, not as a re-shoot. The neck/hand anchors are transferred from avatar.boy-basic-carry's measured values (poses identical by construction; the hood breaks the neck-pinch heuristic and the beige chinos pollute skin-blob detection, the avatar.boy-basic-red precedent), then verified visually with the mug composited.
